Objective
Build capabilities on NVIDIA Omniverse platform
Detecting faults and changing the visual of related parts of Electric circuit with 4 sub-circuit connected to each other
Main Features
Definitions of each part of electrical circuit is stored in predefined master data using python
The detailed information of errors induced in the electric circuit are stored in log files
Alert signals for the parts having defects or showing anomaly 
Custom format for defect visualization
Text Alert
Color change of the component

Objective:
Implementation of the navigation of 3D primitives such  Position Marker and Human character, which acquires coordinates in real time (JSON file input) and navigates these primitives in the direction of those coordinates

Main Features of the Experiment:
Support for input of X, Y, and Z coordinates
Individual navigation of primitives
Navigation of multiple primitives at the same time
Speed can be set dynamically (input from user) for Position Marker

Experimentation:
For Human Character, setting up the speed dynamically 
Animation of multiple Human Characters in Real World scenario
Exploration of Issac Sim for Human character animation (instead of using USD composer)
Exploration of the possibility to integrate with simulation functions to perform animations according to the terrain without speed settings input

Objective: 
Customize the Markup function in USD Composer for two scenarios: either Facilities (3D primitives) and comments/logs are linked or they are not

Main Features:
Display two separate windows for log/comment file content as the facilities are clicked
UI Buttons to open log/comment file
Log/comment file can be edited and changes are reflected in respective windows
Fetch the comment made for each markup and rename thumbnail in specific format

Objective:
